info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Building Maintenance Update API
info.description: The Building Maintenance Update API enables users to modify existing building maintenance records efficiently. This endpoint is used for updating details about maintenance activities related to facilities, allowing businesses to keep their records current and relevant. Typical consumers include facility managers and maintenance coordinators who require timely adjustments to operational information. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their facility management processes, ensuring that all maintenance tasks are tracked and documented accurately.

patch.description: This operation allows users to update the maintenance information for a specific building identified by its resource ID. Ensure that the required fields are included in the request to reflect the latest maintenance data accurately.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the maintenance details for the specified facility. It should contain all the necessary data fields that require updating, formatted in JSON. Ensure that all mandatory fields are included to avoid validation errors.
